name: Muh Quest
summary:
Funny and chaotic mobile adventure game where the player is the main character!

Add your face pics, choose your first outfit and begin your quest!

For all skill levels from beginners to gamers.

Collect coins, grow vegetables and go fishing to stack monies – Build up your Islet, expanding your inventory of outfits, tools, vehicles and more that will all aid you on your journey.

Available on The App Store and Google Play.
